integrity: No independent review or external validation has been conducted. Proof and reproducibility files are provided for evaluation.
scientific_limitations: Congruent cylinders with perpendicular axes only. Central-section minimum, all-affine-section maximum; general off-center area profile, unequal radii and unequal axis angles not established. Historical priority remains provisional owing to inaccessible full text of two older studies of cylinder intersections. Exact proof is analytical; the numerical checker is corroborative.
title: Complete planar-section area profile of the Steinmetz bicylinder
